hero.paragraph: Sixtravel is a premium travel company creating sophisticated journeys across Kerala, India, and the world — private escapes, family journeys, executive travel, corporate movements, destination experiences, and founder-led journeys, brought together with discernment.

differentWay.heading: To see the world.
differentWay.body: Travel has become easier. Exceptional travel has become rarer. At SIX TRAVEL, we believe the best journeys are not defined by how many places you visit, but by how deeply you experience them. We look beyond standard itineraries to discover places with character, experiences with meaning, and moments that stay with you long after the journey ends.

excellence.heading: Effortless excellence.
excellence.body: Luxury isn't simply where you stay. It's everything in between. A remarkable journey is built through hundreds of details: the right destination, the right property, the right route, the right people, the right experience, the right moment. We bring these elements together with precision and purpose. Because true luxury is not excess. It is effortless excellence.

image.alt: Aerial view of a boat gliding across calm turquoise water

ways.title: Private Travel
ways.body: Private escapes, family holidays, celebrations, romantic getaways, and completely personalized journeys, designed around your pace, interests, preferences, and sense of discovery. Personal. Private. Distinctly yours.

ways.body: Executive travel, corporate movements, business delegations, leadership retreats, incentive journeys, and destination programs. We coordinate the details behind seamless corporate travel. Precision in motion.

ways.title: Destination Experiences
ways.body: Travel should be more than arriving somewhere and checking a destination off a list. We create experiences around culture, cuisine, nature, design, discovery, wellness, adventure, and connection.

ways.title: Curated Journeys
ways.body: For individuals, families, groups, and organizations, we create complete journeys where accommodation, transportation, destinations, dining, and hospitality come together naturally. No generic templates.

tiers.title: Kerala
tiers.tagline: Our home. Our heritage. Our beginning.
tiers.body: A land of quiet backwaters, dramatic highlands, expansive coastlines, living heritage, extraordinary cuisine, and deeply rooted culture. We create journeys that reveal Kerala beyond conventional tourism.

tiers.title: India
tiers.body: India is not one destination. It is thousands of stories, landscapes, cultures, and traditions waiting to be discovered — from sophisticated cities to remote escapes, curated differently.

tiers.title: The World
tiers.body: Our journey extends beyond India. We curate destinations across the world based on character, quality, beauty, authenticity, and hospitality. Our world is curated, not catalogued.

kerala.heading: Kerala. An extraordinary world of its own.
kerala.intro: Kerala is not simply where we operate. It is where our understanding of travel begins. SIX TRAVEL reveals Kerala through a more discerning lens — connecting travelers with remarkable stays, intimate experiences, extraordinary landscapes, and the cultural character that exists beyond the postcard.

regions.title: Backwaters
regions.body: Private waterways, elegant houseboats, secluded waterfront retreats, and mornings that unfold at the pace of the water.

regions.title: Highlands
regions.body: Tea estates, spice plantations, mountain forests, mist-covered landscapes, and extraordinary highland retreats.

regions.title: Coast
regions.body: Tropical shores, refined coastal properties, private escapes, and endless horizons.

regions.title: Heritage
regions.body: Architecture, craftsmanship, traditions, art, and stories carried through generations.

regions.title: Culinary
regions.body: Malabar traditions, coastal cuisine, local ingredients, heritage recipes, and exceptional dining experiences.

regions.title: Wellness
regions.body: Ayurveda, nature, stillness, restorative hospitality, and the freedom to disconnect from the noise.

standard.heading: The Six Standard™ — a higher expectation of travel.
standard.intro: The Six Standard is more than a service philosophy. It is the discipline behind every journey we deliver.

principles.title: Curation
principles.line: We choose with intention, not volume.
principles.body: The world offers endless possibilities. Our value lies in knowing which ones deserve your time.

principles.title: Personalization
principles.line: No two journeys need to feel the same.
principles.body: Nothing templated. Nothing excessive. Everything considered around who you are and how you move.

principles.title: Precision
principles.body: The finest travel experiences are created through the relationship between every detail, not a single hotel or destination.

principles.title: Discovery
principles.body: Less itinerary. More immersion. Less tourism. More discovery.

principles.title: Service
principles.line: Seamless support from beginning to end.
principles.body: True luxury is rarely loud. It is the detail already handled before you have to ask.

principles.title: Experience
principles.line: The journey itself becomes the memory.
principles.body: We do not simply arrange the journey. We compose it — so what remains is worth remembering.

curation.eyebrow: The Six Experience™ & The Art of Curation

blocks.title: The Six Experience™
blocks.heading: We don't simply arrange the journey. We compose it.
blocks.body: Every SIX journey begins with a simple question: what should this experience feel like? The finest travel experiences are created through the relationship between every detail: the arrival, the property, the room, the view, the vehicle, the table, the experience, the moment between destinations.

blocks.title: The Art of Curation
blocks.heading: We don't simply choose. We edit.
blocks.body: The world offers endless possibilities. Our value lies in knowing which ones deserve your time. Find the exceptional. Remove the unnecessary. Create the unforgettable.

selective.heading: Exceptional travel demands attention.
selective.body: SIX TRAVEL is not built around volume. We believe truly considered travel requires time — to understand the traveler, study the destination, refine the details, and create something genuinely distinctive. So we remain selective.
selective.closing: Fewer templates. Greater imagination. Closer attention. More memorable journeys.
